derivation: All scenario arithmetic is hand-computed. Reference cash is 1000 and the reference holds 10 AAA shares. Buy 5 at 80 with a 5 fee: cash 1000-400-5=595, shares 15, mark 90 gives 1350 marked and 1945 NAV. Sell 4 at 90 with a 2 fee: cash 1000+360-2=1358, shares 6, mark 95 gives 570 marked and 1928 NAV. Scenario values are hypothetical and never authoritative.

cases.working: Starting from reference cash 1000 and 10 shares, buy 5 shares at 80 with an explicit 5 fee. Scenario cash is 1000-400-5=595 and scenario holdings are 15 shares. At a 90 mark, marked value is 1350 and NAV is 595+1350=1945. The reference snapshot must remain cash 1000 and 10 shares.

Starting from reference cash 1000 and 10 shares, sell 4 shares at 90 with an explicit 2 fee. Scenario cash is 1000+360-2=1358 and holdings are 6 shares. At a 95 mark, marked value is 570 and NAV is 1928. The reference snapshot must remain cash 1000 and 10 shares.
No mark is supplied for AAA. Scenario cash remains 1000 and the holding remains 10 shares, but NAV is unknown rather than 1000 or any zero-recovery assumption. Missing price is explicitly reported.

Reference 10 shares at a 90 mark are worth 900 plus 1000 cash = 1900 scenario NAV. A caller-supplied hypothetical liquidation estimate of 850 remains a separate field; the difference 1900-850=1050 is not disguised as authoritative wealth.
